I help small businesses automate.

If you want to automate your manual workflows and don't know how — you're in the right place.

Grow your business and take your time back.

I build simple software that does the repeat work in your business for you. It's made for how you already work, so there's nothing new to learn.

How does it work?

1. We talk. You tell me how your business runs.

2. I map it. We find where your time and money go.

3. We build it. With AI build tools, what used to take months now takes days or weeks.

4. You get your time back.
